title: How to tell a thing that will last
excerpt: Weight, joints and whether it can be mended. Three questions to ask of a board, a basket or a chair before you buy it.
content:
The bread board in the picture is twenty years old and has been oiled perhaps ten times. It has lasted because it was one piece of wood to begin with.

Three questions

  • Is it heavier than it looks?
  • Can you see how it is joined?
  • If it broke, could someone mend it?

What we do about it

We sell very little, and we use all of it ourselves first. The oak serving board has been through a year of our own kitchen.
